title: When Digitalization Transforms Itself: AI, Software, and the Next Technical Order
abstract: arXiv:2609.15350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) marks a new phase of digitalization: digitalization is beginning to act back upon its own technical production base. Whereas earlier phases aimed at digitizing analog information, automating processes, and building digital value networks, AI is increasingly taking over tasks in the development of digital systems themselves. In software engineering (SE) in particular, agentic AI systems can already plan, execute, check, and iteratively refine development tasks across multiple steps. Digitalization thus becomes recursive: digital systems no longer merely support the digitalization of other sectors, but are increasingly developed and evolved by digital systems themselves. The technical production base of digitalization thereby becomes the object of its own transformation. translated_title: 当数字化转变自身：人工智能、软件与下一个技术秩序
translated_abstract: 代理式人工智能标志着数字化的一个新阶段：数字化开始反作用于其自身的技术生产基础。此前的阶段旨在将模拟信息数字化、实现流程自动化并构建数字价值网络，而人工智能正日益接管数字系统自身开发过程中的任务。尤其是在软件工程（SE）领域，代理式人工智能系统已经能够跨多个步骤规划、执行、检查并迭代完善开发任务。因此，数字化变得具有递归性：数字系统不再仅仅支持其他行业的数字化，而是越来越多地由数字系统自身进行开发和演化。数字化的技术生产基础由此成为其自身转型的对象。这不仅改变了软件工程中人机之间的劳动分工，也改变了软件工程作为一个整体所扮演的角色。本章分析……
tldr: 代理式人工智能使数字化进入递归阶段——数字系统开始开发并演化自身的技术生产基础，这不仅改变了软件工程中的人机分工，也重塑了软件工程的整体角色。
en_tdlr: Agentic AI makes digitalization recursive—digital systems increasingly develop and evolve their own technical production base, transforming both the human-machine division of labor in software engineering and the role of software engineering as a whole.
